To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the curvature of the Ait Attab syncline is a Primary feature that resulted from a strike slip regime, and not a secondary feature that resulted from subsequent rotation about a vertical axes as previously suggested by other workers.
the Ait Atta syncline, a curved fold in the Moroccan High Atlas, has a primary curved shape that is inherited from a pre existing extensional regime.
The Ait Atbat syncline is a positive oroclinal fold that formed during the Cretaceous.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the geometry of a fold and the timing of the deformation that has affected it.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the curvature of the Ait Attab syncline is a result of a pre existing extensional regime, and that the tilting of the red beds is related to the Cenozic inversion of the belt.
the curved geometry of the Ait Ait tab syncline is a first order primary feature, and that the secondary curved fold axes are a secondary feature.
the Ait Atta syncline is an original structure resulting from the influence, during the Early Cretaceous, of pre existing, E W and NE SW striking extensional faults.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ait Atta syncline is a pre Albian structure that has been reactivated during the Cenozoïc.
the Ait Atbat syncline is a positive oroclinal bending that resulted from the interaction of a pre existing, NE striking normal fault and the subsequent strike-slip deformation.
the Ait Atta syncline is a secondary fold that was formed by the reactivation of a pre existing, NE-SW trending, extensional structure during a strike slip tectonic regime.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the geometry of the Ait Attab syncline is primary and that the curvature of the fold is not the result of post tectonic rotation.
curved fold geometries may not necessarily result from subsequent rotation of originally planar fold geometries about a vertical axis, but may instead be primary structures.
paleomagnetic results can be used to decipher the origin of a synclinal curvature, and that the Ait Atta syncline is a good example of a primary curved fold.
